title: How the Padres Bought Stars Without Buying a Dynasty
primaryKeyword: san diego padres world series drought
audience: Baseball readers who want evidence on whether San Diego's star payroll can manufacture a first title—not hype about the next free-agent splash.
metaDescription: San Diego turned star payroll into contention—and still owns baseball's clearest zero-ring conversion problem.
angle: Treat the Padres as baseball's clearest case of buying October access without buying a dynasty: scarce postseason history, two pennants, zero rings, modern payroll elite.
